leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a Vue component that catches and handles errors from its child components
Configure error boundaries to display fallback UI when errors occur
Apply error boundary patterns to isolate component failures
Construct test cases that trigger errors within error boundary components
Initialize error state management within Vue's reactivity system
Render fallback content while preserving the main application functionality
Integrate error boundaries into existing Vue component hierarchies
